denominators.qualification: Not an accuracy percentage. Presence is not correctness. Context counts separate. Edge count includes continuation and optional editorial relation; do not pool as supported semantic-edge denominator.

findings_summary.finding: Both first readings translate the rereading as they feared. The immediate argument is removal of protective clouds and the congregation becoming visible/exposed. Added local Rashi explicitly explains נתראו and ואתחזיאו. Agreement is a shared error, not independent confirmation. The unpointed original spelling remains preserved.
findings_summary.proposed_action: Revise translation to became visible/exposed with source/commentary distinction; retain original records and recheck dependent support to cloud departure.

findings_summary.finding: אמרה ליה explicitly introduces the mother speaking. Producer prose identifies her but structured attribution/utterance voice remains anonymous and holder empty. This is layer loss, not missing narrative content.
findings_summary.proposed_action: Preserve mother as character speaker, and warning rather than narrator-certified causal claim.

findings_summary.finding: Producer paraphrases the child citing Genesis and challenging Yohanan, but structured attribution marks both child reply and counter-question anonymous. Source encounter and named Yohanan question establish interlocutors without assigning a חד אמר by order.
findings_summary.proposed_action: Add contextual child speaker with explicit source anchor to 9a:5-6; preserve question versus quoted scripture roles.

findings_summary.finding: Quoted-authority typing correctly recognizes Proverbs, but no structured speaker preserves the explicitly reciting child (דיתיב ואמר). Narrative prose contains it; attribution layer does not.
findings_summary.proposed_action: Retain quoted authority and add reciter/speaker distinction; do not count the proverb as an independently authored child doctrine.

findings_summary.finding: כל שכן records preference for deeds rectified beforehand. Producer retains the claim but its graph has only the remedy answer, omitting this explicit relation. This is an edge omission, not a missing claim.
findings_summary.proposed_action: Add a faithful qualification/a-fortiori relation or document a schema-appropriate equivalent, with exact endpoints and source span.

findings_summary.finding: ואמר רבי אמי מאי דכתיב explicitly assigns the question to Rabbi Ami; reader question utterance/attribution is anonymous. Producer correctly preserves Ami.
findings_summary.proposed_action: Correct only a future reader revision; preserve frozen first reading.

findings_summary.finding: דאמר ריש לקיש מנין names Resh Lakish as questioner. Reader calls question anonymous and links conclusion rain-for-individual as answer to whence derived; the cited verse is the direct evidentiary answer, correctly linked by producer.
findings_summary.proposed_action: Future reader revision should preserve named question and proof-answer relation; no core credit from context.

findings_summary.finding: Reader propositions say a possibility is excluded, but mark those exclusion propositions rejected. The rejected object is the universal possibility, not the asserted narrowing. Producer question/answer separation avoids that polarity inversion.
findings_summary.proposed_action: Separate rejected alternatives from accepted limitations in future reader revision.

findings_summary.finding: Reader resumes Rabbi Yosi ben Yehuda baraita attribution after the Abahu/Resh Lakish gloss; producer uses anonymous. Resumption is plausible but the unpunctuated text does not independently delimit every quotation boundary. Neither a forced named attribution nor a certified anonymous author is warranted.
findings_summary.proposed_action: Preserve inherited-baraita possibility/uncertainty; do not treat as resolved named scholar-choice data.

findings_summary.finding: Reader explicitly labels an editorial objection edge between temporal alternatives; producer preserves alternative status without a graph objection. These are not direct contradictory temporal propositions, and no explicit objection formula appears.
findings_summary.proposed_action: Do not charge an omission for the optional editorial edge or force a binary dispute.

findings_summary.finding: Four exclusions/three dates/narrative steps are split in reader and combined in producer, whose composite content preserves the components and conditions. Concept mapping is many-to-one; row counts are not omission counts.
findings_summary.proposed_action: Retain separate atomic denominators; no wholesale claim-omission charge.

findings_summary.finding: Reader keeps Yohanan/child candidates for terse dialogue; producer uses anonymous respondent and correctly preserves Hoshaya as reported authority. Do not treat ambiguity as a confirmed wrong named attribution. First recitation request itself clearly belongs to Yohanan, so reader overuncertainty should not spread there. Added Rashi identifies some turns, but it was not part of the original frozen reading and is not silently substituted.
findings_summary.proposed_action: Maintain speaker uncertainty for unresolved turns and distinguish actual reported Hoshaya from dialogue transmitter. Any commentary-based refinement requires explicit provenance.
